leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply TypeScript interfaces to define a prop type for a component that receives a render prop function
Implement a MouseTracker component that tracks mouse position using React state hooks
Use the useEffect hook to attach and clean up mouse movement event listeners
Define a render prop function that receives mouse coordinates as parameters
Invoke the render prop function within the MouseTracker component to pass mouse data
Construct a component structure where MouseTracker wraps child content via render props
Utilize the MouseTracker component in a parent component by providing a render function
Access mouse position data (x, y) within the render function to display dynamic content
Return JSX elements from the render function that respond to mouse movements
Control component rendering by passing different render functions to the same MouseTracker
Modify the render prop implementation to handle different mouse events (mousemove, mouseenter)
Apply TypeScript generics to make the render prop pattern type-safe for different data types
